scenario.topic: Decide on the visual style for a mobile puzzle game

options.name: Minimalist Flat Design
options.upside: Ensures clear gameplay elements and fast rendering on all devices.
options.concern: May appear less visually engaging to players seeking rich graphics.

options.name: Hand-drawn Cartoon Style
options.upside: Creates a friendly and approachable atmosphere that appeals to casual players.
options.concern: Requires more art resources and slightly longer production time.

options.name: 3D Low-Poly Style
options.upside: Adds depth and visual interest while maintaining performance on mobile devices.
options.concern: May complicate UI clarity and increase development complexity.

options.name: Retro Pixel Art
options.upside: Appeals to nostalgia and supports simple, recognizable gameplay visuals.
options.concern: Might not attract players expecting modern graphical styles.

shared_context: The team must select a visual style for a mobile puzzle game targeting casual players aged 18-35. The style should support clear gameplay visibility and be feasible to implement within a 3-month development cycle.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a game designer focused on nostalgic aesthetics and player emotional connection.
personas.private_goal: To choose a style that evokes nostalgia and simple, recognizable visuals.

A.reason_for: Minimalist Flat ensures clear gameplay visibility and fast rendering.
A.reason_against: Feels too plain and lacks the nostalgic charm that appeals to casual players.

B.reason_for: Hand-drawn Cartoon creates a friendly atmosphere that casual players enjoy.
B.reason_against: Requires more art resources and longer development time, which may be risky.

C.reason_for: 3D Low-Poly adds visual interest and depth to the game.
C.reason_against: Could complicate UI clarity and increase development complexity.

D.reason_for: Retro Pixel art appeals strongly to nostalgia and supports simple, recognizable visuals.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a technical lead prioritizing efficient development and performance.
personas.private_goal: To select a style that is feasible within the 3-month timeline and performs well on all devices.

A.reason_for: Minimalist Flat design offers low complexity and short development time, ensuring clear gameplay and fast rendering.

B.reason_for: Hand-drawn Cartoon style is appealing and still feasible within a medium development timeframe.
B.reason_against: Requires more art resources and slightly longer production time.

C.reason_against: Increases development complexity and may hurt UI clarity, risking timeline goals.

D.reason_for: Retro Pixel art is simple and recognizable.
D.reason_against: May not appeal to players expecting modern graphics and has a short-medium development time.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a UX artist focused on clarity and user-friendly visuals.
personas.private_goal: To ensure the visual style supports clear gameplay visibility for casual players.

A.reason_for: Minimalist Flat design provides clear gameplay elements and fast rendering, ideal for casual players.

B.reason_for: Hand-drawn Cartoon style creates a warm, approachable atmosphere.
B.reason_against: Requires more art resources and longer development time.

D.reason_against: Might not meet expectations for modern graphical styles.
